The throwing guard is `assertCan()` in `src/lib/permissions.ts`. It throws `PermissionDeniedError` where `can()` returns a boolean. Fourteen source files call it. Files that only mention it in comments or imports, such as `permission-gate.tsx`, `action-errors.ts`, and `invite-member-form.tsx`, are excluded, as are the tests.

I checked the call sites with grep rather than reading each file in full, so the list reflects matching `assertCan(` calls.

Call sites are in `src/server/services/`:
- activity-service.ts, attachment-service.ts, billing-service.ts, comment-service.ts, feature-flag-service.ts, invitation-service.ts, issue-service.ts, label-service.ts, member-service.ts, notification-service.ts, organization-service.ts, project-service.ts, search-service.ts, webhook-service.ts
